defects.problem: The impact frames carry a huge effect. Frame 5 is a frame-filling white/blue starburst that hides Sasuke completely and has a stray grey blob at the top edge. Frames 6-8 are a lightning cage as wide as the frame, drawn over his whole body. The game holds these frames while the hitbox is out and draws Chidori Nagashi itself.
defects.detail: 5<-4, 6<-4, 7<-9, 8<-9 (frame 4 has the arms flung wide with only small sparks in the hands; frame 9 has the arms wide with a faint thin ring)

defects.problem: He does not crouch. Frames 1-3 are the normal fighting stance, only about 9% lower, with the knees barely bent. In game the crouch looks like standing still, and the low pose the hurtbox expects is never shown.
defects.detail: drops into a deep crouch on the spot and holds it, facing right: squats all the way down until the hips almost touch the heels, both knees fully bent, torso leaning forward over the knees, the head lowered to about half its standing height, fists still raised in guard in front of the face. Only Sasuke is drawn

defects.problem: The impact frame is wrong. Frame 1 is the wind-up, with the sword hanging limp down and back and no swing yet. The cut behind him lands in frame 2 (the arc sweeping low behind him), and the blade stays extended behind him in frames 4-6.

Between the behind-sweep (frame 2) and the blade held out behind (frames 4-5), frame 3 throws the sword arc out IN FRONT of him (to the right), off the right edge. For one frame the back air reads as a forward slash.

The impact frame is wrong. Frame 1 is still the running wind-up with the sword raised, and the slash lands in frame 2 (the horizontal cut trail across the front). The white trail in frame 2 ends flat at both sides of the frame, but it still reads as the cut.

Nothing reads as dizzy. All 8 frames are the alert fighting stance with the hands raised in guard and almost no sway: the arms do not hang loose and nothing wobbles. After a shield break the player sees him simply idling.
defects.detail: stunned and dizzy, facing right: slumps with the knees sagging and the back hunched, both arms hanging limp at his sides, the head lolling and rolling in a slow circle, the upper body tottering left and right on the spot, a seamless loop that returns exactly to the first pose. Only Sasuke is drawn

defects.problem: The cut is hidden behind a huge white, cyan and blue slash crescent. In frame 6 it fills the frame and covers his legs and the blade at the impact frame. In frame 7 it covers his lower body. The lightning in frames 2-4 also stretches far behind him. It is several colours, and the white is the same as his shirt, so it cannot be erased cleanly.
defects.detail: powerful two-handed overhead sword slash: raises the straight sword high above and behind his head, then cuts down hard to the front, the blade ending low in front of him pointing right, holds the cut for a moment, then returns to the ready stance with the sword held upright in front. Only Sasuke is drawn

defects.problem: The frame edge cuts off his hands at full reach: the fingers end in a straight vertical line, so the grab shows stumps. Frame 0, the impact frame, also has white speed lines and red streaks drawn over his face and belt.
defects.detail: frame 0 <- frame 3, frame 1 <- frame 3, frame 2 <- frame 3. Frame 3 has the same lunge with arms fully extended and the open hands whole, and impact stays 0.

defects.problem: The slam lands at frame 3, when both hands first hit the ground. Frames 4-6 are almost the same held pose, so with impact 6 the throw hits about 3 frames after he is already down.

There is no lunge and no thrust. The clip opens already holding the blade level across his chest: the hilt is back by his rear hip, the front arm is empty and not extended, and frames 0-3 are nearly static. It then only raises the sword back to the vertical ready stance, so the action is just the recovery. The impact frame (7) is the ready pose with the sword pointing straight up, so the frame held while the hitbox is out shows no blow. He also turns from a 3/4 front view (0-4) to side profile (5-7) partway through.
defects.detail: fast one-hand thrust: from the ready stance he steps forward into a deep lunge and stabs the straight sword straight ahead to the right with his sword arm fully extended, the blade level at chest height and reaching far in front of his body, holds it for an instant, then pulls back to the ready stance. Only Sasuke is drawn

defects.problem: A large red-and-white hit-spark starburst is drawn over his face. It hides the whole head and reaches the right edge of the frame. The game draws its own hit sparks, so this one would double up. Its white streaks cross the face, so erasing the red would leave holes.
defects.detail: frame 0 <- frame 1 (the clip plays 1,1,2,3; the head snap and recoil still read). The few tiny salmon specks to the right of the head in frame 1 can be erased at the same time if convenient.

defects.problem: This is not a helpless fall. The arms are spread out to the sides for balance and the legs are tucked or reaching, the same as the jump/fall poses. The arms are not limp above the head, and the body does not turn. A player cannot tell the helpless state from a normal fall. Frame 7 (tightly tucked) also pops against frame 0 at the loop point.
defects.detail: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms raised limp above his head with the hands dangling, head tipped back, legs hanging loosely straight down, the body slowly turning as he drops, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Sasuke is drawn
